title: Credits
description: See your available and reserved credits and every change to them.
heldHelp: A task reserves its quote when it starts, is charged its actual usage as it completes, and releases what is left.

about.title: How credits work
about.reserve: Reserve: submitting a task sets aside the quote you confirmed; nothing is spent yet.
about.settle: Charge: each step is charged the usage the provider reports; without a report, the reserved amount is charged.
about.release: Release: when the task ends, whatever was reserved and not charged returns to your available credits.
about.overage: If usage exceeds the reservation, the difference comes from available credits and is listed separately.

topup.title: Demo top-up
topup.note: No payment: nothing is charged; this is for demos and testing only.
topup.unavailable: Top-ups are not available yet; ask an administrator for credits.

ledger.title: Credit history
ledger.emptyBody: Once you submit a task, its reservation, charges and release appear here.
ledger.notSum: Reserve, charge and release are stages of the same task; do not add them up. What you spent is in "Charge".

remark.hold_retry: Reserved the quote for a retry
remark.hold_upgrade: Reserved more after confirming the preview
remark.commitShortfall: Charged actual usage; {{n}} beyond the reservation came from available credits
